description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InteropTransferAlreadyOnHoldException' for the Apache Fineract project, used to indicate that a transfer is already on hold or has already been committed.

classes.name: InteropTransferAlreadyOnHoldException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that an interoperation transfer is already on hold or has been committed, extending the base domain rule exception.

methods.name: InteropTransferAlreadyOnHoldException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error code and message, including accountId and transferCode details.

calls: super("error.msg.interop.transfer.already.committed", "Transaction with transferCode " + transferCode + " already committed for account " + accountId)
